dialog.content: Maba is a hybrid architecture combining dynamic guided decay attention with dynamic centroid routing and hierarchical cross attention.
How does DGDA ensure constant memory during decode?
DGDA maintains a fixed-size recurrent state matrix updated incrementally via associative delta updates, keeping decode memory O(1) with respect to sequence length.
Explain centroid routing in the block sparse stream.
The indexer computes block centroids using a hybrid mean-max reduction and gathers the top-k most relevant historical key-value blocks with logarithmic distance penalty.
Why is high-capacity associative pooling used?
HCA summarizes long-term historical context into pooled tokens, allowing queries to attend to ultra-long horizons with minimal compute overhead.
How are the three attention streams combined?
The model applies an input-dependent gating network that computes a convex combination of local window, block-sparse, and HCA representations.
